description: Sober's standard library HTTP/1.1 server (std/http on std/net, TLS 1.3 from std/tls), default configuration. One task per connection; one io_uring and one SO_REUSEPORT listener per worker — each worker accepts on its own ring and runs the connection itself (epoll fallback), with workers pinned one per CPU. Routes are a plain table ([]http.Route with method, :param / *rest patterns, Mount / Merge, before / after middleware), JSON through std/json, gzip through the built-in compress: option of the server. Static ELF with no libc, FROM scratch.
